title: Sunkissed & Salty | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Just a 2-Minute Walk to the Beach * Private Pool (Heat additional fee)* Fire Pit – Gather under the stars and enjoy relaxing evenings together* Ping Pong Table * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Pet Friendly ($200
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beach Home!* Just a 2-Minute Walk to the Beach * Private Pool (Heat additional fee)* Fire Pit – Gather under the stars and enjoy relaxing evenings together* Ping Pong Table * 4 Complimentary Bikes * Pet Friendly ($200 add'l fee applies)* Close to 30A Shopping and Dining* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area. *Welcome to Sunkissed & Salty, a stylish and spacious luxury beach home just a 2-minute walk from the sugar-white sands, this five-bedroom retreat is designed for families and groups who want to relax. Spend your days at the beach, then return home to your private pool for a refreshing swim. Pool heating is available for an additional fee, making the pool an inviting option throughout the year. The outdoor space is perfect for entertaining, with a patio for grilling, a fire pit and a ping pong table for a little friendly fun. Inside offers three King bedrooms, a bedroom with two Queen beds, and a spacious bedroom featuring two Queen-over-Twin bunk beds. The flexible sleeping arrangements make this home especially convenient for families traveling with children or multiple groups vacationing together. The bright, open-concept living area provides a comfortable place to gather, while the gourmet kitchen makes preparing meals for your entire group easy. Whether you're spending the day in the surf, relaxing by the private pool, challenging the family to a game of ping pong, or gathering around the fire pit at night, Sunkissed & Salty is the perfect Seacrest Beach retreat!The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King Bed Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom 3: 2 Queen Beds Guest Bedroom 4: 2 Twin-over Queen BedsArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
